title.en: An Act Appropriating Seven thousand and Ninety-Two Pesos for the Improvement of Buildings and Grounds At Baguio, Benguet.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any Appropriation, funds in the Insular Treasury not
otherwise appropriated, for improving the sanitary condition of small cottages inhabited by Filipino
employees at Baguio; for installing open drains in connection therewith; for providing baths and sinks in such
cottages; and for the construction of gravel walks and the provision of adequate lighting at night, seven
thousand and ninety-two pesos, which sum shall be expended by the Bureau of Public Works.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 21, 1912.
